Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Hänt Extra was the “Macedonian weekly” simply because it was verified as a weekly magazine, conflating “weekly” with “Macedonian” and ignoring evidence that Hänt Extra is Swedish. They also failed to properly investigate Tea Moderna (e.g., by searching its Macedonian name “Теа Модерна” or using site:mk), so lack of immediate results was incorrectly treated as disproof, leading to the wrong answer.
